placements.title: Governing deployment verification and release controls

placements.title: Mandating signed release manifests for staging and production deployments
placements.frame: What verification criteria and ownership mandates must be satisfied before deployments can ship to staging or production?
placements.why: Captures the policy requiring cryptographic manifest signatures on all Meridian deployments across staging and production to prevent unsigned artifact leaks.
